items.title: Introducing Book Mode: A Better Way to Learn on AlgoMaster.io
items.author: Ashish Pratap Singh
items.content:
We’ve just introduced across all courses on !

You can now go through any course just like reading a real book, with a Kindle-like experience designed to make learning more comfortable, focused, and enjoyable.

To try it out, open any course and click the button in the bottom bar. Give it a try .

Most existing course features are also available in Book Mode. You can switch between Book Mode and the regular course view anytime without losing your progress.

  • Enjoy a familiar, book-like experience with more space for content.

  • Distraction-free reading: A clean, focused interface that makes it easier to concentrate, especially during longer study sessions.

  • Multiple reading formats: Choose the layout and reading style that works best for you using the reading settings.

  • Seamless progress syncing: Switch between Book Mode and the regular course pages without losing your place.

  1. Click the in the bottom-right corner.

  2. Start reading in Book Mode.

You can switch back to the regular course view anytime.

Built for a better learning experience

Some topics are easier to understand when you can read through them at your own pace, without distractions or unnecessary navigation.

That’s what Book Mode is designed for. It brings the simplicity of reading a book to the interactive learning experience you already have on AlgoMaster.

Give it a try and let us know what you think. We’re always looking for ways to make learning more effective and enjoyable.
